hook: A fatal high-speed train collision in Urda killed 69 people, forcing a drastic new safety mandate.

sections.voiceover: A fatal high-speed train collision in Urda killed 69 people, forcing a drastic new safety mandate.
sections.visual_cue: Aerial shot of the Madrid-Sevilla rail line in Toledo, Spain.
b_roll: Aerial footage of Spanish high-speed railway tracks

sections.voiceover: Renfe launched these emergency protocols after this tragedy followed another accident on the Madrid-Sevilla line. What specific operational changes prevent future signaling failures on the Madrid-Sevilla high-speed line?
sections.visual_cue: Renfe corporate logo and official safety document icon.
sections.sfx_cue: Sound of a train horn passing in the distance.
b_roll: Graphic showing the Madrid-Sevilla high-speed line

sections.voiceover: However, the directive mandates that trains halt immediately if the LZB cab signaling system fails.
sections.visual_cue: Close-up of a train driver's cab display showing a signal error.
b_roll: Close-up of modern train cab control panel
Warning light flashing on a console

sections.voiceover: Drivers now proceed at a maximum speed of 40 km/h under visual supervision until clear. Renfe confirms this visual checking process is essential to prevent further tragedies in Spain.
sections.visual_cue: Split screen showing a train moving slowly past a signal post.
sections.sfx_cue: Sound of train wheels on tracks at low speed.
b_roll: Train moving slowly through a station
Driver looking out of train window

sections.voiceover: Safety operations now require this 40 km/h visual speed limit.
sections.visual_cue: Wide shot of a train receding into the distance.
b_roll: Wide shot of high-speed train on rural track
